about_the_game:
Fields of Mine is a tense roguelike where the classic logic of old-school Minesweeper turns into a deadly run for survival. You’ve got a handful of seconds, a single life, and a field full of mines. One wrong move can cost you dearly — sometimes your entire run.

Every minefield is a puzzle. Every choice is a deal with the devil: will you take a powerful buff at the cost of precious time? Or accept a debuff to buy yourself a few more seconds? You shape your own fate — and every step could be your last.

Survive through three procedurally generated maps filled with mini-bosses, shady merchants, and deadly traps. The goal is simple: stay alive.

🧩 FEATURES:

⏱ Time-based tactical gameplay — make fast, thoughtful decisions under pressure.

🎲 A roguelike with unique runs — dozens of effects, random maps, events, and upgrades.

⚖️ Risk or safety — you choose — trade time for power, or take a penalty for a better shot at survival.

🧠 Classic Minesweeper logic — now with real consequences.

♻️ High replayability — no two runs are ever the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows7/8.1/10
  • Processor: Core i3 of Sandy Bridge generation or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics Series (It needs 1GB memory allocation)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Devices compartible Direct Sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows7/8.1/10 (64bit ver)
  • Processor: Core i5 of Ivy Bridge generation or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce (VRAM 1GB or better)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Devices compartible Direct Sound

short_description: Fields of Mine is a tense roguelike built on classic Minesweeper logic. Clear random fields, balance buffs and penalties, and manage your time. One wrong step — and it’s all over in an explosion.
